entries.name: Fatigue load
entries.summary: Fatigue load reflects accumulated strain, reduced readiness, or incomplete recovery.
entries.coreRecommendationBias: Use conservative recommendations when fatigue evidence is high and recovery evidence is incomplete.

entries.name: Strain recovery mismatch
entries.summary: A mismatch between high strain and low recovery increases uncertainty and should trigger missing-evidence review.
entries.coreRecommendationBias: Explain why recovery evidence may not support higher-intensity action.
